objective: Interrogate already-derived sanitized PCAP evidence through fixed bounded operations while preserving capture coverage and never requesting raw packets or new collection.
preconditions: an admitted parsed-evidence artifact already exists for the selected request
the local derived-PCAP query policy and capture digest are available
the question maps to a fixed allowlisted operation and typed filters
required_evidence: capture digest parser provenance and bounded request identity
coverage completeness decode and time-bound metadata
sanitized connection or packet-fact rows with truncation and scan accounting
positive_evidence: attributable derived connection or packet facts corroborate the scoped network hypothesis
coverage metadata and selected-scope markers show that the supporting observation falls inside the admitted capture bounds
negative_evidence: a successful complete non-truncated derived query over a complete decoded capture returns no scoped matches
complete coverage and admitted packet facts contradict the exact tuple protocol or timing hypothesis
escalation_pivots: inspect capture coverage before treating any empty operation as negative evidence
pivot among fixed connections protocol and packet-fact operations using the same admitted artifact
record unavailable when raw payload or a new capture would be required

query_templates.purpose: Read exact coverage scalars for the already-derived artifact before interpreting result absence.
Read bounded sanitized connection summaries from the existing parsed artifact with fixed typed filters.
Read bounded aggregate packet facts without raw payload packet bytes paths commands or parser arguments.

alternative_hypotheses: the capture is partial asymmetric encrypted or snap-length limited
the relevant stream falls outside capture time or selected scope
parser coverage or malformed records hide relevant facts
the observed behavior is legitimate application traffic or infrastructure activity
stop_conditions: the discriminating question is answered by attributable derived evidence and coverage
the question requires a new capture raw PCAP payload or packet export
the question requires a parser shell network call or filesystem path
the next fixed operation has low expected information value or the query budget is exhausted
confidence_limiters: sampled or aggregated rows do not establish completeness
no raw PCAP parser shell or network access exists at this boundary
known_false_positive_patterns: routine monitoring health checks and keepalives
normal retransmission retries or protocol negotiation
